pairs.question: Quid enim refert quantum habeas?
pairs.answer: Multo illud plus est quod non habes.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question and its immediate self-answer, the only genuine interrogative-and-answer in the file. The question runs to the '?'; the answer is the following full sentence which directly responds. No scaffolding (fr. label, Gellius citation) included. Other fragments are purely declarative with no real Q&A.
